rubrics.justification: Accurately interprets the provided Gardner components, correctly flags the 2AA vs full-blastocyst description inconsistency, and avoids fabricating unseen image features; limited only because no actual image was available and zona/visual details could not be assessed.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor context, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with clear distinction between morphology-only prognosis and case-adjusted prognosis, and conclusions are well supported by the history.

Generally well aligned with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer principles, and evidence-based workup after recurrent failure; minor limitation is somewhat speculative implantation percentages and selective PGT-A discussion without stronger caveats.

Provides specific, practical next steps for the current transfer and future planning, including luteal timing, early ectopic surveillance, cavity/tubal reassessment, sperm DNA testing, and review of embryology performance.
